paper_title: Анализ и политика на състоянието на енергетиката по икономическия индикатор енергийна зависимост
caption: Структура на крайното потребление на енергия по сектори, %
model_annotation: The diagram is a donut chart that represents the distribution of energy consumption across different sectors, comparing the percentage share of each sector. The chart is divided into five sectors. The sectors are labeled as "Индустрия" (Industry) with a blue color and 28.0% share, "Транспорт" (Transport) with a red color and 34.6% share, "Услуги" (Services) with a green color and 12.6% share, "Домакинства" (Households) with a purple color and 22.9% share, and "Селско стопанство" (Agriculture) with a light blue color and 1.9% share. The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to the sector labels and displays the percentage share for each sector. The percentages are also directly labeled on the chart next to their corresponding sectors. The sectors appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, starting from the top, with the largest sector "Транспорт" (Transport) followed by "Индустрия" (Industry), "Домакинства" (Households), "Услуги" (Services), and the smallest sector "Селско стопанство" (Agriculture).
